entities.summary: Mark Moiseyevich Rozental was a Soviet philosopher and teacher, specializing in the fields of dialectical materialism, aesthetics, and the history of philosophy. He and Pavel Yudin were the main authors of A Dictionary of Philosophy, a Soviet dictionary on philosophy.
